text: GIC, the Singaporean state investor established to manage Singapore's foreign reserves, owns 14.2% of Visma.
short: GIC, Singapore's sovereign wealth fund, owns 14.2% of Visma.

source.name: Visma: Investors — Governance (Board and shareholders)
source.quote: GIC owns 14.2% of Visma. GIC is a leading global investment firm established in 1981 to manage Singapore's foreign reserves.

additionalSources.name: The Guardian: Norway's €19bn software company Visma picks London for IPO
additionalSources.quote: Other investors include Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC, the Singaporean private equity firm Intermediate Capital Group, Canada's CPP Investments and the Texas-based private equity group TPG.
additionalSources.note: The Guardian names GIC among Visma's investors but gives no percentage; the 14.2% figure is Visma's own disclosure.
